title: Answer: brains whose neurons use quantum processes are conscious, deterministic machines likely not

statements.text: Consciousness belongs to brains whose neural networks use quantum processes for energy efficiency, and even a simple predictive model, such as a creature anticipating a predator, adds conscious cognition to awareness. Strictly deterministic algorithmic machines are unlikely to replicate it.

sources.quote: it may simply be enough to enable a creature to anticipate the way a predator is likely to pounce
